Stockholm: Novo Nordisk said on Wednesday it ‌had ⁠won ⁠a preliminary injunction against Ceban Ziekenhuisfarmacie from a district court in the Netherlands in a patent infringement case involving a ⁠compounded semaglutide nasal ‌spray.

Semaglutide is the active ingredient ⁠in Novo Nordisk's weight-loss drug Wegovy.

"The ​Court found that ​Ceban infringed Novo Nordisk's supplementary protection certificate (SPC) covering semaglutide," the Danish drugmaker said in ‌a statement.

It said the court ordered ​Dutch ​firm ⁠Ceban to cease the infringing activities, remove product listings, disclose ​supply chain information, and reimburse Novo Nordisk's legal costs.

Source : Reuters
